## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -4.01% | 1M: -14.70%) BELOW TREND and strong sector breadth confirm risk appetite, while credit signal mixed—HYG (1W: +0.64% | 1M: +0.55%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.78% | 1M: +0.74%) ABOVE TREND contrast with negative regime score, creating the cautionary split.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stress EASING: HYG (1W: +0.64% | 1M: +0.55%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.78% | 1M: +0.74%) ABOVE TREND. Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -4.01% | 1M: -14.70%) BELOW TREND; Stocks vs Bonds flat: SPY/TLT (SPY 1W: +0.57% | 1M: -0.08% RECOVERY; TLT 1W: +0.83% | 1M: +1.54% ABOVE TREND).

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-benign: Yield curve rising (↑) and TLT (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +1.54%) ABOVE TREND show duration preference, while UUP (1W: -0.25% | 1M: +1.60%) CORRECTION indicates a softer dollar near-term.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Semis leading: SOXX (1W: +10.46% | 1M: +12.86%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +2.50% | 1M: +4.50%) ABOVE TREND show tech/semis strength; Energy lagging: XLE (1W: -0.21% | 1M: -0.14%) BELOW TREND. Style: Growth/momentum bias as tech and small caps lead.

**5. US vs Global?**
US resilience: SPY (1W: +0.57% | 1M: -0.08%) RECOVERY and QQQ (1W: +2.31% | 1M: +0.93%) ABOVE TREND; EM catch-up: EEM (1W: +5.09% | 1M: +1.00%) ABOVE TREND while FXI (1W: +1.55% | 1M: -7.76%) RECOVERY shows China uneven.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculative appetite mixed but present: IWM (1W: +4.01% | 1M: +3.64%) ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +5.57% | 1M: -20.12%) RECOVERY show risk-on flows, while the Speculation Index is in CORRECTION.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Industrial/reflation signals emerging: CPER (1W: +3.86% | 1M: -1.79%) RECOVERY and Copper/Gold ratio ↑ rising ABOVE TREND, while Gold GLD (1W: -2.45% | 1M: -10.21%) BELOW TREND is under pressure.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy weakening: BNO (1W: -6.60% | 1M: -14.38%) BELOW TREND and XLE (1W: -0.21% | 1M: -0.14%) BELOW TREND; natural gas UNG (1W: -2.74% | 1M: +3.37%) CORRECTION shows short-term volatility.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Semis/Tech leadership—SOXX (1W: +10.46% | 1M: +12.86%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +2.50% | 1M: +4.50%) ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: SPY (1W: +0.57% | 1M: -0.08%) RECOVERY and several 1W/1M mismatches (CIBR, SKYY, UNG) signal transitional internals to monitor.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor selective risk exposure to semiconductors/tech and small caps (SOXX, XLK, IWM) while reducing exposure to energy and beaten commodities (XLE, BNO); monitor credit spreads and SPY/TLT for regime confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: SOXX (1W: +10.46% | 1M: +12.86%) ABOVE TREND, IWM (1W: +4.01% | 1M: +3.64%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: BNO (1W: -6.60% | 1M: -14.38%) BELOW TREND, XLE (1W: -0.21% | 1M: -0.14%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: CPER (1W: +3.86% | 1M: -1.79%) RECOVERY on reflation signal. BEARISH: GLD (1W: -2.45% | 1M: -10.21%) BELOW TREND and BNO (1W: -6.60% | 1M: -14.38%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (VXX 1W: -4.01% | 1M: -14.70%) BELOW TREND as complacency check; Credit spread ~0.7333 (1W: -0.37% | 1M: -0.33%) → flat as stress barometer; Tech vs Financials ratio 3.4646 (1W: -2.24% | 1M: +0.44%) CORRECTION as a leadership pivot to watch.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive, creating a split between strong internals and mixed risk signals. Semiconductors/Tech and small caps showing relative strength (SOXX, XLK, IWM); key risk is the transitional internals—SPY RECOVERY vs monthly weakness and credit/commodity divergences to monitor.
